# CRITERION CHANGED 2026-09-17 coo, SCRIP this landing: CALLBACKS, ON CEO-836's WORD THAT THE NUMBER IS NOW LOAD-BEARING. The 63 was wrong three ways and the third is the one that mattered. (i) THE SCOPE WAS TWO HAND-NAMED FILES AND ONE OF THEM HOLDS NO SITE: gen_runtime.c contributes zero, so the census read ONE file while naming two, and FIVE real sites of the identical class stood outside any denominator, in pattern_match.c, rt/rt.c and core/core.c. The scope is now DERIVED by walking src/runtime and src/driver -- 86 files. (ii) A DECLARATION IS NOT A CALL SITE: the filter tested the line's TERMINATOR, so a prototype ending ';' and a one-line definition ending '}' both counted -- FIFTEEN of the 63 were declarations, including five of the rt_call_arr_* forwarders at by_name_dispatch.c:5167-5171. The test is now the declarator prefix BEFORE the name, with the C keywords that may precede a call excluded. (iii) THE CRASH THE NUMBER IS SUPPOSED TO BOUND WAS NOT IN IT: the regex matched calls TO the dispatcher and never the callback OUT of it, so by_name_dispatch.c:5260 `out = APPLY_fn(fn, args, nargs);` -- the exact gdb site CEO-836 traced, the raw heap name pointer live across a call into emitted code -- was outside the census entirely. OUTBOUND is now its own printed population over a DECLARED set (APPLY_fn, _usercall_hook, rt_chain_enter, rt_chain_enter_v) that REFUSES rc=2 if a named symbol leaves the tree. (iv) RT_GC_CALLBACK IS DEFINED NOWHERE IN src/: wrapped=0 was never 'nobody has wrapped one yet', and a no-op macro would have taken this census to GREEN with no semantic change -- the definition's absence is now PRINTED beside the count. THE ARITHMETIC CLOSES: 63 -> 48 on the same two files once a declaration stopped counting (-15), -> 53 when the scope was derived (+5 real sites the old scope never opened), and a SECOND key beside it, callbacks.unwrapped_outbound = 13, which is where by_name_dispatch.c:5260 finally appears. THIS IS THE INSTRUMENT GETTING HONEST, NOT A LANDING GOING BACKWARDS -- one tree, one sitting, no cure landed and none claimed.

# CRITERION UNCHANGED, COUNT EARNED 2026-09-18 cto, SCRIP this landing: safe-points.unpolled 109 -> 97 (measured on the rebased tree; the row was cut against 117 and the ceo's batches 3 and 4 took 117 -> 109 under it, so the twelve sites this landing polls are the same twelve either way). THE SPILL RECORD OF ARCH-GC 6.5 (x86_rt_gc_poll_rec_sigma, gate test_gate_gc_the_spill_record_carries_a_callee_saved_heap_pointer_across_an_allocating_return.sh, WIRED 414): the twelve DEFERRED pattern-primitive sites -- rt_pat_prim_str in bb_match_any/notany/break/breakx(x2)/span and rt_pat_prim_int in bb_match_len(x2)/pos/rpos/tab/rtab -- return a LONG, not a DESCR, and sit inside a pattern blob where r13 holds the subject base. Neither the bare poll nor the 6.5b spill-PAIR can take them: the pair spills an untagged integer into the word-swept range, and gc_zeta_frame visits any word landing in a heap block raw AND rewrites it when the block slides (the ceo's CEO-890 measurement, which is why 6.5 says TAGGED CELLS). The record hands rt_gc_point_arr_c ONE tagged {DT_S, slen=r15d, s=r13} cell as its shield array and the CALLER's own rsp as the floor, so the tagged cell is visited precisely and relocated while the untagged result below the floor is never swept. FAIL-ONCE, measured live with the pair in its place: a deferred LEN(*N) match under SCRIP_GC_STRESS=1 printed its captures as 0xDB poison -- a WRONG ANSWER, not a crash. NOTHING ABOUT THE CRITERION MOVED: same census, same denominator of 210; the poll spelling is the emitter helper's own name, which carries rt_gc_poll, so no --poll-helper was needed.

# ⛔ CRITERION CHANGED 2026-09-18 cto, SCRIP this landing: safe-points. A TAIL JUMP IS A CALL-GRAPH EDGE, AND LEAVING IT OUT PUT 27 ALLOCATING CALL SITES OUTSIDE THE DENOMINATOR ENTIRELY -- neither polled nor counted unpolled, in the number this emergency is steered by. allocating_entries 1584 -> 1683, allocating_call_sites 210 -> 237, unpolled 97 -> 123. THE CAUSE: allocating_entries_from_binary recorded `call` edges only, and the hand-written asm allocators in src/runtime/rtx/rtx_alloc.s -- rt_str_alloc and rt_agg_alloc -- reach the carve by a TAIL JUMP (`jmp .Lga_armed` on the armed path, `je c_rt_str_alloc` to the C fallback) and never execute `call rt_gcheap_alloc`. So they, AND the 99 functions that reach the heap only through them -- the SNOBOL4 string builtins among them: DUPL_fn, REVERS_fn, SUBSTR_fn, TRIM_fn, BCHAR_fn, _CHAR_, _COLLECT_, _ITEM_ -- read NON-ALLOCATING. A tail jump IS an edge for the question this census asks: control reaches the target, the target may allocate, and it returns past us to OUR caller with the caller's frame live. objdump prints an intra-function jump as <fn+0xNN> and the symbol pattern refuses a '+', so only true inter-function transfers are recorded and a self-edge is dropped -- two new planted selftest arms hold both directions (selftest 39 -> 43 arms). ⭐ THIS IS THE INSTRUMENT GETTING HONEST, NOT A LANDING GOING BACKWARDS: the same tree, 27 sites that were never counted before, and every one of them genuinely unpolled. Found by the cto while generating the emitter's allocating table (row gc-the-emitter-emits-the-poll-not-the-template, gate test_gate_gc_the_allocating_set_is_a_generated_table_gated_against_the_call_graph.sh arm 4, which holds rt_str_alloc and rt_agg_alloc in the table by name so the narrowing cannot come back in silence).
